label: Neighbourhood
intro: Mártonhegy offers the tranquillity of the Buda Hills while remaining well connected to the city. Well-regarded Hungarian schools and a strong choice of international schools make the neighbourhood particularly appealing to families. Local cafés, shops and healthcare are within easy reach, while the woodland trails of Normafa offer space for recreation and time outdoors.
